goal: Daily closes are one in-process series per listing; Yahoo period is fetch metadata, not store identity
non_goals: Do not mutate archive/research or archive/outcomes history
Do not merge QuoteService with HistoryService
Do not add a disk cache, Cache type, or Yahoo daemon
Do not change last-print TTL or 1m+5d snapshot
success_criteria: HistoryService store is listing-keyed; get_many(listings, since=) is the only read
Yahoo period tokens live in YahooHistoryBackend / period_covering, not mtm_path or alt_history_view
GET /api/price-history?range= slices the JSON body and does not use range as the store key
Errors are not cached; FakeHistoryBackend tests cover 5y-then-1y hit and 1y-then-5y miss
